rows.en: I see, so you control Giant Robo? All right, leave this end to us!

Giant Robo? So you're the boy Oyassan was talking about? Got it, leave the hostages to us!
Giant Robo? So you're the boy Oyassan was talking about? Got it, leave the hostages to us!
Giant Robo? So you're the boy Oyassan was talking about? Got it, leave the hostages to us!
You? Giant Robo's…? Roger! We'll rescue the hostages!
You? Giant Robo's…? Roger! We'll rescue the hostages!
I see, so you're Giant Robo's controller? Got it! We'll rescue the hostages, no matter what… I promise!
I see, so you're Giant Robo's controller? Got it! We'll rescue the hostages, no matter what… I promise!
Oh, so you control Giant Robo? Okay. You don't need to worry about the hostages.
I see, so you're Giant Robo's controller? All right, we'll rescue the hostages.
I see, so you're Giant Robo's controller? All right, we'll rescue the hostages.

Thank you!!

All right… Giant Robo, launch!!
Mah!
Robo's too far away!! I can't give orders unless I get closer!
Aah, Giant Robo!
I'm counting on you, Giant Robo! Megaton Punch!
We did it! Robo really is the strongest!

Oh, you're back…

I was watching the TV broadcast the whole time! Looks like your joint front with Giant Robo went well, eh?
Yes… Giant Robo's even more than the rumors said…
We rescued the hostages safely, and the soccer match has started up again.

That's right!

Goro… Minami said he wanted to see you! He says let's play soccer again…

Please come to Unicorn's Japan Branch with everyone now. I want to show you my Robo up close, too…
That's right! Everybody needs a breather now and then. Go on, off with you! Ha ha ha…
Thanks to the Riders, young Daisaku Kusama and Giant Robo, BF's kaiju was defeated and the hostages were rescued safely.
Robo's frame was beautiful and powerful… The Riders gazed at it as if to burn the sight into their eyes.
The related facilities in this district seem to have fallen into their hands too! Please leave this to us, the Security Team!

…!? So you're the Security Team chief I've heard about?

All right! I'll leave seizing the related facilities to your unit! Leave these guys to us! I'm counting on you!
Hoah, hoaaah!!
Eh, eiii, eiiiiii!!
Shhh, shhhhh!
Ugyaaah!!
Banbaaa…
Aaah!! R-Robooo!!
Waaaaagh…
All right… Giant Robo, launch!!
Defeat Itsutsu Banbara, the Phantom Soldiers, the Shocker Executive Monsters and all Shocker Combatants!
Defeat Executive Monster Bat Man and all of the Shocker army and the Phantom army!
Defeat the electric kaiju Sparky!
Daisaku Kusama is defeated
Giant Robo is defeated
Yoshiko, the "X-Alpha Solution," please…

Yes…

Doctor… I wonder whether this experiment will truly bring back a dog that's been dead for three whole weeks…
Mm. Is everything ready?
Yes…
Doctor! The dog's come back to life! Doctor, Dr. Otaguro!!
Yoshiko!

Doctor! We finally did it!

We succeeded in bringing back to life a dog that had been dead for three weeks!
Yes… Thank you, Yoshiko! It's all thanks to you.
Oh, Doctor, please… don't say such things.
Yoshiko, deliver these research materials to the TDF's science group! Tell them it was completed well ahead of schedule…
Yes, Doctor… I'm sure everyone will be delighted.
Mm, I'm counting on you!

Colonel Zol…

In order to resurrect our Shocker cyborgs as revived monsters, we must seize the research materials on the X-Alpha Solution at all costs!

To that end… I have summoned from the Swiss Branch one of our Shocker's top executives, Doctor Death.
What did you say!? Doctor Death?

That's right…

Doctor Death will steal the frozen corpses of the physicist Dr. Edward and the mathematician Dr. Keynes from the London Museum and bring them to Japan!

We will revive the two men hailed as the greatest scholars of this century with the X-Alpha Solution and have them build revived monsters as members of Shocker's science group!

Steal the X-Alpha Solution research materials without Kamen Rider and his allies noticing!
Nngh…
Angered at Colonel Zol for letting Takeshi Hongo and the others steal away Kamen Rider 2, Hayato Ichimonji, the Leader of Shocker summoned another top executive to Japan.
His name was Doctor Death… Shocker's foremost genius scientist and an excellent commander as well. At Doctor Death's summoning, Colonel Zol felt a sense of urgency.
Hey, Taki… You've got an emergency message!
An emergency message?
From where?

This is… from FBI Headquarters in New York!

Let's see… "Decoding of Shocker cipher indicates a Shocker top executive is scheduled to arrive in the Tanzawa area at 13:00 today.

Connected to Operation World Darkness… Investigate immediately!" That's what it says.
Operation World Darkness? This is bad. We have to find out somehow!
You got it! Let's go!
Wait! What about Dr. Otaguro's assistant… Yoshiko Hashimoto?
We created something called the X-Alpha Solution, which, depending on how it's used, could be extremely dangerous…

Yes, it sounds like quite something!

According to this morning's paper, it can apparently bring back to life creatures that have been dead for days, isn't that right?

Yes…

And on her way to deliver those research materials to the TDF, Yoshiko was… by Shocker…

…!?

I can't just sit here! I have to rescue Yoshiko as soon as possible…
No! You mustn't! If you go wandering out there, Dr. Otaguro, that'd be exactly…

Besides, Doctor… This is Shocker we're talking about, and they don't miss a thing!

They might have guessed you'd come to rescue Yoshiko and be lying in wait!
They're the kind of guys who'd do it…

But then… then I'd owe Yoshiko far, far too much.

If it would save Yoshiko… I… I'd gladly go to Shocker…
Leave it to us… We'll rescue Yoshiko!
Yes… These fellows can be trusted. You can rest easy and leave it to them.
[HERO2], let's go too.
Yeah… of course!
All right… I'll go after this Shocker top executive!
Then I'll handle Yoshiko…
[HERO2]… What will you do?
